The wp_ajax_fv_player_db_save handler's ownership and capability check is conditional on the presence of the data.update field; omitting it bypasses authorization entirely, allowing a Subscriber-level attacker to overwrite any existing video record using an enumerable video ID — and the valid nonce required by the endpoint is issued to every logged-in visitor of any page hosting the publicly accessible [fvplayer_editor] shortcode.

web-token jwt-framework and jwt-library before 3.4.12, 4.0.x before 4.0.8, 4.1.x before 4.1.10, and 4.2.x before 4.2.4, and jwt-encryption-algorithm-ecdh-es through 3.2.10, have a ConcatKDF::generate() that performs a single SHA-256 round, deriving at most 32 bytes for ECDH-ES and ECDH-SS direct key agreement. Anyone holding a JWE using A256CBC-HS512 can decrypt it under an all-zero AES key, while A192CBC-HS384 content keys have only 64-bit strength.

Dockhand before 1.0.50 contains an improper access control vulnerability that allows authenticated unprivileged users to read restricted data by querying API endpoints lacking RBAC checks. Attackers can access /api/users, /api/license, and /api/hawser/connect to obtain user emails and roles, the full license key, and environment details, while an invalid license grants all users admin rights.

Dockhand before 1.0.57 contains a cross-site request forgery vulnerability that allows attackers to perform state-changing actions by exploiting missing Origin header validation and absent CSRF tokens. Attackers can lure authenticated users to a same-site attacker page that submits forged POST requests to stop, start, or delete stacks, modify settings, and change credentials.

Frappe ERPNext before 15.124.2 and 16.x before 16.53.0 fails to enforce record-level authorization in several endpoints, reports and forms, allowing authenticated low-privilege users to access data beyond their role. Attackers can send crafted requests naming out-of-scope records to read other companies' financial, stock, pricing and contact data or make constrained changes to those records.

Frappe ERPNext before 15.121.4 and 16.x before 16.36.0 contains a missing authorization vulnerability in a CRM and Support module endpoint that returns Communications of documents without checking whether the caller may read them. Authenticated attackers with a common operational role can send crafted requests naming out-of-scope records to read their email communications and relink them away from their original documents.

Frappe ERPNext 8.2.5 before 15.121.4 and 16.x before 16.36.0 contains a missing authorization vulnerability in a Stock module endpoint that returns on-hand stock quantities without checking record-level permissions. Authenticated attackers, including portal users or users without roles, can send crafted requests naming restricted records to disclose stock quantities and confirm item existence.

Frappe ERPNext 10.0.0 before 15.122.0 and 16.x before 16.50.0 contains a missing authorization vulnerability in an Accounts module endpoint that returns Payment Term settings without checking whether the caller may read the specific records requested. Authenticated attackers, including portal users or users with no assigned roles, can send crafted requests naming records outside their permitted scope to read Payment Term settings.

Frappe ERPNext 11.0.0-beta before 15.121.4 and 16.x before 16.36.0 contains a missing authorization vulnerability in a Selling module endpoint that returns customer loyalty point balances without checking the caller's permission on the requested records. Authenticated attackers, including portal users or users with no assigned roles, can send crafted requests naming records outside their permitted scope to read other customers' loyalty point balances.

Frappe ERPNext 11.1.7 before 15.121.4 and 16.x before 16.36.0 contains a missing authorization vulnerability in a Regional module endpoint that returns private e-invoice files after checking only document-type permissions, not per-record User Permissions. Authenticated attackers with a common operational role can send crafted requests naming out-of-scope records to read other companies' private e-invoice files.

Tapo C120 and C200 contain an improper authentication vulnerability within the login
authentication verification module. An attacker on the local network can
exploit weaknesses in challenge parameter validation to bypass normal
authentication controls and obtain administrative session tokens. 









Successful
exploitation may allow an attacker to subsequently execute privileged
management actions, enable unauthorized administrative access and temporary
disruption of device services, resulting in a denial-of-service (DoS)
condition.

Frappe ERPNext 15.94.2 before 15.122.0 and 16.x before 16.50.0 contains an incorrect authorization vulnerability in a supplier portal endpoint whose party identity check ignores party type, failing to distinguish a Customer and a Supplier that share a name. Authenticated users, including portal users or users with no assigned roles, can send crafted requests naming records outside their permitted scope to read buying-portal records.

Frappe ERPNext 13.49.0 before 14.0.0, 14.17.2 before 15.124.0, and 16.x before 16.52.0 contains a missing authorization vulnerability in a Selling module endpoint that returns Sales Order line items without checking whether the caller may read the requested records. Authenticated attackers, including portal users or users with no assigned roles, can send crafted requests naming out-of-scope Sales Orders to read their line item data.

Frappe ERPNext 13.0.0 before 15.122.0 and 16.x before 16.50.0 contains a missing authorization vulnerability in an Accounts module endpoint that returns Bank Transaction amounts and bank accounts without checking whether the caller may read the requested records. Authenticated users with a common operational role can send crafted requests naming out-of-scope records to read Bank Transaction data of other companies.

Frappe ERPNext 12.2.0 before 15.122.0 and 16.x before 16.50.0 contains a missing authorization vulnerability in an Assets module endpoint that returns Asset details without checking whether the caller may read the requested records. Authenticated attackers, including portal users or users with no assigned roles, can send crafted requests naming records outside their permitted scope to read restricted asset details.

Frappe ERPNext 15.111.0 before 15.121.4 and 16.22.0 before 16.36.0 contains a missing authorization vulnerability in an Accounts module endpoint that returns item rows of a caller-named inter-company invoice or order and accepts a caller-supplied document type without checking read permission. Authenticated attackers, including portal users or users with no roles, can send crafted requests naming another company's document to read Sales Invoice, Purchase Invoice and order items.

Frappe ERPNext 5.0.0 before 15.121.4 and 16.x before 16.36.0 contains an incorrect authorization vulnerability in a Selling module endpoint that checks only document-type write permission, not permission on each Sales Order, when closing or reopening Sales Orders. Authenticated users restricted by User Permissions can send crafted requests naming another company's Sales Order to close or reopen it outside their restriction.

Frappe ERPNext 11.0.0-beta before 15.122.0 and 16.x before 16.34.0 contains a missing authorization vulnerability in an Accounts module endpoint that returns the subscription plans linked to a caller-named invoice without checking read permission on that invoice. Authenticated attackers can send crafted requests naming invoices outside their permitted scope to learn whether they belong to subscriptions and read the billed plans.

Frappe ERPNext 4.3.0 before 15.121.6 and 16.x before 16.37.0 contains an SQL injection vulnerability in an endpoint of the Selling and Buying modules, where a request value validated early can be overridden by caller-supplied data that reaches a database query unvalidated. Any authenticated user, including a portal user with no roles, can send crafted requests to extract sensitive data, including active session data, and take over other accounts such as administrators.

Heym before 0.0.148 passes Playwright navigate-step URLs to page.goto() without validating the scheme and runs step-based scripts inside the backend container. A signed-in user who can run workflows can navigate to file:// URLs and use getText to read known-path files such as the Kubernetes ServiceAccount token or Docker secrets.

rclone before 1.76.0 leaks credentials in its swift, netstorage and seafile backends, which follow HTTP redirects using Go's default policy: swift and netstorage send auth headers or passwords on cross-host or HTTPS-to-HTTP redirects, and seafile sends API tokens or passwords on same-host HTTPS-to-HTTP redirects. Attackers receiving or observing a redirect issued by the configured endpoint can capture these credentials to access storage or replay signed requests.

Rclone from 1.46.0 before 1.76.0 contains a memory exhaustion vulnerability in the remote control server that allows unauthenticated clients to crash rclone by sending oversized JSON bodies. Attackers can POST large JSON payloads to protected RC methods, which handlePost decodes before authorization checks, triggering out-of-memory termination and interrupting transfers.

ArcadeDB from 26.7.1 before 26.11.1 contains an information disclosure vulnerability because LSMTreeFullTextIndex computes BM25 corpus statistics over all buckets of the indexed type, ignoring bucket access control on subtypes. Authenticated users with read access to a supertype but not its subtype can run EXPLAIN or PROFILE on full-text queries and read totalDocs and per-term df values to count hidden subtype documents containing chosen terms.

@better-auth/stripe 1.2.0-beta.18 before 1.7.16 and 1.8.0-beta.0 before 1.8.0-beta.5 contains an authorization bypass vulnerability because the stripeCustomerId user field accepts values from sign-up and update-user requests, letting a user replace their own Stripe customer ID with another customer's. Attackers who know another customer's Stripe ID can open that customer's billing portal to view invoices and billing details, change payment methods, and cancel or modify subscriptions.

SurrealDB 3.0.0 before 4.0.0 contains a permission bypass vulnerability that allows authenticated low-privilege database users to read restricted records by calling the GET /export endpoint. Attackers can export raw records that skip table SELECT predicates and field-level SELECT permissions, exposing other users' rows and hidden fields.

SurrealDB from 2.2.0 before 4.0.0 contains an authorization bypass vulnerability in Document::purge_references that lets authenticated users bypass target table PERMISSIONS by triggering REFERENCE ON DELETE cascades. Attackers can delete a referenced record to delete, unset, or run CUSTOM expressions on referencing records despite PERMISSIONS FOR delete or update NONE.

SurrealDB 1.0.0 before 4.0.0 prints SURREAL_PASS and SURREAL_TOKEN environment variable values in clear text in the --help and -h output of CLI commands such as surreal start, sql, import, export, and mcp, because the arguments do not set clap's hide_env_values. Anyone who later sees that terminal output, for example in shell logs, CI logs, or screen shares, can obtain root database credentials.

Vikunja 2.3.0 before 2.8.0 contains an uncontrolled memory allocation in the CSV migration module because it does not de-duplicate label column mappings or cap labels per row, and enforces the item limit only after the full import is built. Authenticated users can send one request to /api/v2/migration/csv/migrate with repeated label mappings or many labels per row, exhausting memory until the server is OOM-killed.

Vikunja from 2.6.0 before 2.8.0 contains a resource exhaustion vulnerability in the Planka migration converter that multiplies task allocations for duplicate list IDs. Attackers controlling a Planka server can return boards with duplicate list IDs and many cards to exhaust memory and OOM-kill the Vikunja process.

Vikunja from 0.21.0 before 2.8.0 contains a resource exhaustion vulnerability that allows authenticated users to trigger instance-wide database writes by setting a project position below 0.1. Attackers can repeatedly send PUT requests to /api/v2/projects/{id} so recalculateProjectPositions updates every user's root projects, holding SQLite's write lock and degrading availability.

Admidio from 5.0.2 before 5.0.17 contains an arbitrary file read vulnerability that allows any logged-in member to read server files by placing local paths in img src attributes of eCard messages. Attackers can send an eCard to their own account so sendEcard() embeds files like adm_my_files/config.php via addEmbeddedImage(), disclosing database credentials and /etc/passwd.

Admidio from 5.0.0 before 5.0.18 contains a path traversal vulnerability in DocumentsService::renameFile() that allows authenticated users to move files outside adm_my_files by supplying an unvalidated adm_new_name value. Attackers with folder upload permission can submit ../ sequences to file_rename_save to write files and create directories in arbitrary writable locations, including the web root.

SiYuan 3.6.0 before 3.8.10 contains an information disclosure vulnerability that allows authenticated Readers to read protected documents through block-reference footnote resolution in Markdown export. Attackers can request copyStdMarkdown for a public document referencing a hidden, disabled, or password-protected document to disclose its body text without the publish password.

SiYuan 3.8.0 before 3.8.10 contains an information disclosure vulnerability in LAN sync that allows adjacent unauthenticated attackers to obtain device metadata by advertising a counterfeit peer with a replayed discovery tag. The client sends the sync scope ID, device name, OS, app version, and TLS client certificate to /peer-sync/v1/session/open before validating the server proof.

A security vulnerability has been detected in Chaterm up to 0.12.2 on Windows. The affected element is an unknown function of the file resources/app-update.yml of the component Auto-Update Mechanism. Such manipulation leads to download of code without integrity check. It is possible to launch the attack remotely. This attack is characterized by high complexity. The exploitability is described as difficult. The vendor was contacted early about this disclosure but did not respond in any way.

A weakness has been identified in Drakeling Labs Operation Harsh Doorstop up to 0.14.2.1 Build 19523588. The impacted element is the function LaunchURL of the component Workshop Configuration. This manipulation causes unrestricted upload. It is possible to initiate the attack remotely. Upgrading to version 0.14.2.2 Build 26092794 is sufficient to resolve this issue. Upgrading the affected component is advised.

OpenAirInterface CN5G AMF before 2.2.2 contains a missing resource release vulnerability in amf_sbi::handle_itti_message() that leaves stale PDU session contexts when NRF lookup or SMF selection fails. Authenticated UEs can request PDU sessions while no SMF is selectable, causing deregistration to wait on SMF release timeouts and stall shared NAS processing for other UEs.

Improper Neutralization of Special Elements used in an SQL Command ('SQL Injection') vulnerability in Metagauss ProfileGrid profilegrid-user-profiles-groups-and-communities allows Blind SQL Injection.This issue affects ProfileGrid: from n/a through 6.0.0.6.

Improper Neutralization of Special Elements used in an SQL Command ('SQL Injection') vulnerability in JoomUnited WP Media folder wp-media-folder allows Blind SQL Injection.This issue affects WP Media folder: from n/a through 6.2.8.

Improper Neutralization of Input During Web Page Generation ('Cross-site Scripting') vulnerability in BuddyPress BuddyPress buddypress allows Stored XSS.This issue affects BuddyPress: from n/a through 14.5.4.

Improper Neutralization of Input During Web Page Generation ('Cross-site Scripting') vulnerability in Wetail AB WooCommerce Fortnox Integration woocommerce-fortnox-integration allows Stored XSS.This issue affects WooCommerce Fortnox Integration: from n/a through 4.8.1.

Portainer Community Edition and Business Edition 2.39.0 before 2.45.1 contain a server-side request forgery vulnerability because user-supplied URLs are only syntax-checked by validate.IsURL without resolved address validation. Authenticated users can abuse Git cloning, Helm retrieval, registry ping, or the GitLab proxy to reach loopback, internal, and cloud metadata addresses, probing ports and reading responses.
Improper Neutralization of Input During Web Page Generation ('Cross-site Scripting') vulnerability in nK Ghost Kit ghostkit allows Stored XSS.This issue affects Ghost Kit: from n/a through 3.8.1.

Improper Neutralization of Input During Web Page Generation ('Cross-site Scripting') vulnerability in seowriting SEOWriting seowriting allows Stored XSS.This issue affects SEOWriting: from n/a through 1.15.0.

Improper Neutralization of Input During Web Page Generation ('Cross-site Scripting') vulnerability in PluginUs.Net HUSKY woocommerce-products-filter allows Stored XSS.This issue affects HUSKY: from n/a through 1.4.8.

Improper Neutralization of Input During Web Page Generation ('Cross-site Scripting') vulnerability in Bootstrapped Ventures WP Recipe Maker wp-recipe-maker allows Stored XSS.This issue affects WP Recipe Maker: from n/a through 10.9.2.

Assimp 6.0.0 through 6.0.6 contains an infinite loop vulnerability in SkipLine that allows attackers to hang parsing by supplying files with '#' comment lines. Attackers can provide crafted OFF, LWS, or MD3 shader files so ReadFile never returns, consuming a CPU core and denying service.

Assimp through 6.0.6 contains an out-of-bounds write vulnerability in glTFAsset.inl that allows attackers to corrupt memory via oversized glTF 1.0 accessor elements. Attackers can supply a crafted glTF 1.0 file with VEC4 position or VEC3 index accessors to overflow heap or stack buffers during import, crashing applications.

Linkwarden before 2.17.0 contains an incorrect authorization vulnerability in the archive upload handler that allows collection members with only add permission to modify other users' links. Attackers can send POST requests to /api/v1/archives/<linkId> to replace another user's stored screenshot, PDF, readable, or HTML archive with attacker-supplied content.

Tandoor Recipes before 2.7.4 contains a path traversal vulnerability in Nextcloud.get_file that allows authenticated recipe editors to write and delete files by using unsanitized recipe names in temporary paths. Attackers can set a recipe name containing ../ segments via PATCH /api/recipe/<pk>/ and request /api/get_recipe_file/<pk>/ to overwrite and remove .pdf files outside the temporary directory.

Gradio 6.27.0 before 6.32.0 contains an authentication bypass vulnerability in gradio/history.py that allows remote unauthenticated attackers to use the operator's locally saved Hugging Face token by sending a forged Host: localhost header. When ssr_mode is enabled, requests proxied through the local Node SSR server pass the loopback check, letting attackers call run history endpoints to list buckets, read records and assets, and write buckets under the operator's account.

sigstore-js @sigstore/oci before 0.8.0 contains a credential exposure vulnerability that leaks registry credentials by replaying OAuth2 password-grant request bodies on cross-origin 307 or 308 redirects. Attackers who can make a trusted token service redirect to their host via open redirect or compromise receive the username and password POSTed by RegistryClient.

Reposilite 3.5.27 before 3.6.7 contains a brute-force protection bypass vulnerability that allows unauthenticated remote attackers to evade login bans by spoofing the X-Forwarded-For header. Attackers can rotate the header value to make unlimited password or token guesses, or forge failed attempts to lock out legitimate clients.

DBHub before 1.7.0 contains a read-only mode bypass vulnerability that allows MCP clients restricted to readonly execute_sql to run write and DDL statements via backslash-escaped quotes. Attackers can hide stacked statements that clear transaction_read_only or COMMIT inside strings misparsed by scanSingleQuotedString, letting them modify or drop MySQL, MariaDB, or PostgreSQL data.

Donetick through 0.1.86 contains a blind server-side request forgery vulnerability that allows self-registered users to make the server send requests by setting unvalidated circle webhook or Discord notification URLs. Attackers can point these URLs at loopback or internal services, causing EventsProducer and the Discord notifier to POST partly attacker-influenced bodies to internal network hosts.

HedgeDoc before 1.12.1 contains a prototype pollution vulnerability in the POST /history/:noteId endpoint that allows authenticated users to modify Object.prototype by supplying __proto__ as the noteId. Attackers can send a pinned value to /history/__proto__, which historyPost() in lib/history.js assigns onto the prototype, crashing the Node.js process and causing denial of service for all users.

ntop nDPI through 6.0 contains a heap out-of-bounds read and unsigned length underflow in ndpi_serializer_get_buffer() in src/lib/ndpi_serializer.c when stripping leading NUL and space bytes. Buffers holding only spaces or NULs, or a used length of 0 set through ndpi_serializer_set_buffer_len(), cause reads past the heap buffer or a wrapped 4294967295 length, crashing the embedding application.

The Web-Based Management (WBM) authorization model does not properly enforce permissions for all PROFIBUS configuration operations. A low-privileged remote attacker can abuse an exposed configuration function to modify root-owned PROFIBUS parameters, including device addressing and SSA settings. This allows unauthorized changes to fieldbus-related configuration and violates the intended privilege boundaries within the management interface.

A vulnerability was detected in osCommerce 4.14.63493. The affected element is an unknown function of the component Backend Administration List Controller. Performing a manipulation of the argument order[0][dir] results in sql injection. It is possible to initiate the attack remotely. The vendor was contacted early about this disclosure but did not respond in any way.

A vulnerability was determined in osCommerce 4.14.63493. Affected is the function CheckoutController::actionRestart of the file lib/frontend/controllers/CheckoutController.php of the component Checkout Order Restart. This manipulation of the argument order_id causes sql injection. The attack may be initiated remotely. The vendor was contacted early about this disclosure but did not respond in any way.

msgpack-c C++ library cpp-3.0.0 through cpp-9.0.0 contains a use-after-free vulnerability in the Boost.X3 parser in include/msgpack/v2/x3_parse.hpp when built with MSGPACK_USE_X3_PARSE in reference mode. Attackers can supply crafted msgpack input parsed over buffering iterators so decoded str, bin and ext objects hold dangling pointers, disclosing freed heap memory or crashing the process.

Medplum server 5.1.4 before 5.1.42 contains an incorrect authorization vulnerability in the Binary $presigned-url operation that allows non-admin project members to overwrite other projects' Binary content. Attackers in a project linked to another project can request a signed upload URL with upload=true for a readable Binary and overwrite its stored content, since project ownership is never verified.

PodFetch 5.2.0 before 5.3.1 contains a missing authorization vulnerability in the Audiobookshelf-compatible POST /api/podcasts endpoint that allows authenticated low-privilege users to add podcasts by bypassing role and USER_PODCAST_LIMIT checks. Attackers with the plain user role can submit attacker-chosen feed URLs in media.metadata.feedUrl to force server-side fetching and episode downloads, consuming disk and bandwidth.

ai.summary_en: Today's vulnerability landscape is characterized by widespread remote code execution and privilege escalation risks targeting enterprise infrastructure, with Microsoft ecosystems accounting for the majority of high-severity flaws across desktop operating systems, cloud services, and databases. Memory corruption vulnerabilities in Windows networking protocols, SQL Server, and Office applications facilitate unauthenticated attacks, while cloud platforms and web portals suffer from authentication bypasses and injection flaws that threaten identity management and data integrity. Concurrently, critical weaknesses in IoT firmware, industrial control devices, and AI development tools expose operational technology and automated workflows to supply chain compromises and unauthorized device manipulation.
ai.summary_zh: 当前的漏洞态势以针对企业基础设施的大规模远程代码执行和提权风险为特征，其中 Microsoft 生态系统占据了桌面操作系统、云服务及数据库中绝大多数高危漏洞。Windows 网络协议、SQL Server 和 Office 应用程序中的内存损坏漏洞助长了未认证攻击，而云平台和 Web 门户则因身份管理绕过及注入漏洞威胁着身份管理与数据完整性。同时，IoT 固件、工业控制设备及 AI 开发工具中的关键弱点使运营技术和自动化工作流面临供应链遭渗透及设备被非法操控的风险。

items.reason_en: Incorrect authorization in Microsoft Office SharePoint allows an authorized attacker to elevate privileges over the network, directly impacting enterprise endpoint security and data confidentiality.
items.reason_zh: Microsoft Office SharePoint 中的授权错误允许已授权攻击者通过网络提权，直接影响企业终端安全和数据机密性。

items.reason_en: Stack-based buffer overflow in MS Office Excel enables remote code execution via malicious documents, representing a high-value target for phishing and drive-by attacks.
items.reason_zh: MS Office Excel 中的基于栈的缓冲区溢出可通过恶意文档实现远程代码执行，是网络钓鱼和挂马攻击的高价值目标。

items.reason_en: Command injection in the RPM package manager triggers arbitrary code execution during source RPM installation, compromising build automation and system administration workflows.
items.reason_zh: RPM 包管理器中的命令注入会在安装源 RPM 时触发任意代码执行，破坏构建自动化和系统管理流程。

items.reason_en: Heap-based buffer overflow in Windows SMB allows network-based code execution, continuing the legacy of critical file-sharing protocol exploits.
items.reason_zh: Windows SMB 中的基于堆的缓冲区溢出允许基于网络的代码执行，延续了关键文件共享协议漏洞利用的传统。

items.reason_en: Memory corruption in Windows Print Spooler Components enables unauthenticated privilege escalation over the network, targeting ubiquitous printing infrastructure.
items.reason_zh: Windows Print Spooler Components 中的内存损坏可允许未认证攻击者通过网络提权，针对广泛部署的打印基础设施。

items.reason_en: Unauthenticated heap overflow in Microsoft Office Excel delivers remote code execution via malicious documents, a common initial access vector.
items.reason_zh: Microsoft Office Excel 中的未认证堆溢出可通过恶意文档实现远程代码执行，是常见的初始访问向量。

items.reason_en: Weak authentication mechanisms in Windows Kerberos allow network-based privilege escalation, threatening domain controller security and lateral movement defenses.
items.reason_zh: Windows Kerberos 中的弱身份验证机制允许基于网络的提权，威胁域控制器安全和横向移动防御。

items.reason_en: Integer underflow in the Storage Spaces Controller allows an unauthorized attacker to execute code over a network. This network-accessible RCE flaw directly compromises core storage subsystems.
items.reason_zh: Storage Spaces Controller 中的整数下溢允许未授权攻击者通过网络执行代码。此网络可访问的 RCE 漏洞直接破坏了核心存储子系统。

items.reason_en: Heap-based buffer overflow in the Remote Desktop Client enables remote code execution for unauthenticated attackers. Widespread RDP usage makes this a high-priority target for lateral movement.
items.reason_zh: Remote Desktop Client 中的基于堆的缓冲区溢出可为未认证攻击者启用远程代码执行。RDP 的广泛使用使其成为横向移动的高优先级目标。

items.reason_en: Untrusted search path in the Remote Desktop Client allows privilege escalation over a network. Path manipulation vulnerabilities severely impact remote administration security.
items.reason_zh: Remote Desktop Client 中的不受信任的搜索路径允许通过网络提权。路径操纵漏洞严重影响远程管理安全。

items.reason_en: Use-after-free in Microsoft Office Excel permits remote code execution via malicious documents. High real-world attack value due to frequent phishing vectors targeting end-users.
items.reason_zh: Microsoft Office Excel 中的释放后使用漏洞可通过恶意文档允许远程代码执行。由于频繁针对终端用户的网络钓鱼向量，其实际攻击价值很高。

items.reason_en: Heap-based buffer overflow in Microsoft Office Outlook facilitates remote code execution through crafted emails. Directly impacts email clients commonly targeted by spear-phishing campaigns.
items.reason_zh: Microsoft Office Outlook 中的基于堆的缓冲区溢出可通过特制邮件实现远程代码执行。直接影响常被鱼叉式网络钓鱼活动针对的电子邮件客户端。

items.reason_en: Out-of-bounds read in Windows Text Services Framework allows local privilege escalation. Compromises system integrity when exploited by authenticated users or existing malware.
items.reason_zh: Windows Text Services Framework 中的越界读取允许本地提权。当被已认证用户或现有恶意软件利用时，会破坏系统完整性。

items.reason_en: Heap-based buffer overflow in Windows Input System enables local privilege escalation. Affects core input handling subsystems critical to desktop stability and security boundaries.
items.reason_zh: Windows Input System 中的基于堆的缓冲区溢出可启用本地提权。影响对桌面稳定性和安全边界至关重要的核心输入处理子系统。

items.reason_en: Heap-based buffer overflow in Microsoft XPS Document Converter allows remote privilege escalation. Network-accessible service exploitation increases the attack surface for enterprise environments.
items.reason_zh: Microsoft XPS Document Converter 中的基于堆的缓冲区溢出允许远程提权。网络可访问服务的利用增加了企业环境的攻击面。

items.reason_en: Heap-based buffer overflow in Windows Storage Spaces Controller enables remote privilege escalation. Offers broader privilege impact than similar network-accessible storage flaws.
items.reason_zh: Windows Storage Spaces Controller 中的基于堆的缓冲区溢出可启用远程提权。相比类似的网络可访问存储漏洞，它提供更广泛的权限影响。

items.reason_en: Null pointer dereference in Windows Remote Desktop causes denial of service over a network. Impacts availability of critical remote administration tools and user workflows.
items.reason_zh: Windows Remote Desktop 中的空指针解引用会导致网络上的拒绝服务。影响关键远程管理工具和用户工作流的可用性。

items.reason_en: This out-of-bounds write vulnerability in the Windows Search Component carries a critical CVSS score of 9.8 and enables remote code execution over the network, posing a severe threat to core operating system stability.
items.reason_zh: Windows Search Component 中的此越界写入漏洞具有 9.8 的严重 CVSS 评分，可允许通过网络执行远程代码，对核心操作系统稳定性构成严重威胁。

items.reason_en: A heap-based buffer overflow in Microsoft Office Excel allows network-based code execution, representing a high-value target for phishing campaigns distributing malicious documents.
items.reason_zh: Microsoft Office Excel 中的基于堆的缓冲区溢出允许基于网络的代码执行，是分发恶意文档的网络钓鱼活动的高价值目标。

items.reason_en: Cross-site scripting in Visual Studio Code permits unauthorized network code execution, highlighting critical security gaps in widely used developer environments that process untrusted inputs.
items.reason_zh: Visual Studio Code 中的跨站脚本漏洞允许未经授权的基于网络的代码执行，凸显了处理不可信输入的广泛使用的开发环境中的关键安全缺陷。

items.reason_en: Path traversal flaws in Microsoft Office Outlook enable network-based code execution by exploiting email client trust boundaries, facilitating rapid lateral movement upon opening crafted attachments.
items.reason_zh: Microsoft Office Outlook 中的路径遍历漏洞通过利用电子邮件客户端的信任边界实现基于网络的代码执行，在打开特制附件后促进快速横向移动。

items.reason_en: Heap-based buffer overflow in Microsoft Office Word allows remote code execution over a network. Its high CVSS score and widespread deployment make it a prime target for phishing campaigns.
items.reason_zh: Microsoft Office Word 中的基于堆的缓冲区溢出允许通过网络执行远程代码。其高 CVSS 评分和广泛部署使其成为网络钓鱼活动的首要目标。

items.reason_en: Double free vulnerability in Microsoft Office Visio enables remote code execution with a CVSS of 9.8. Exploitation directly compromises enterprise document workflows and user endpoints.
items.reason_zh: Microsoft Office Visio 中的重复释放漏洞可实现远程代码执行，CVSS 为 9.8。利用该漏洞直接破坏企业文档工作流和用户终端。

items.reason_en: Stack-based buffer overflow in the Desktop Window Manager allows local privilege escalation. Compromising core UI components grants attackers full control over active user sessions.
items.reason_zh: Desktop Window Manager 中的基于栈的缓冲区溢出允许本地提权。破坏核心 UI 组件将使攻击者完全控制活跃的用户会话。

items.reason_en: Critical heap-based buffer overflow in NTFS allows remote code execution over the network, posing a severe risk to core file storage systems.
items.reason_zh: NTFS 中的关键基于堆的缓冲区溢出允许通过网络执行远程代码，对核心文件系统构成严重风险。

items.reason_en: Race condition in the SMB server transport driver enables remote code execution, directly impacting widely targeted file sharing and network discovery protocols.
items.reason_zh: SMB 服务器传输驱动程序中的竞态条件可启用远程代码执行，直接影响被广泛针对的文件共享和网络发现协议。

items.reason_en: Heap-based buffer overflow in the Windows Codecs library allows remote code execution via malicious media files, representing a common initial access vector for attackers.
items.reason_zh: Windows Codecs 库中的基于堆的缓冲区溢出可通过恶意媒体文件实现远程代码执行，代表攻击者常用的初始访问向量。

items.reason_en: Use-after-free in the Windows NAT component permits remote code execution over the network, compromising critical network address translation infrastructure.
items.reason_zh: Windows NAT 组件中的释放后使用漏洞允许通过网络执行远程代码，破坏关键的网络地址转换基础设施。

items.reason_en: Use-after-free in the TCP/IP stack allows remote code execution on adjacent networks, affecting fundamental operating system networking operations.
items.reason_zh: TCP/IP 协议栈中的释放后使用漏洞允许在相邻网络上执行远程代码，影响操作系统的基础网络操作。

items.reason_en: Heap-based buffer overflow in Windows Media Foundation allows network code execution. Its 9.8 CVSS score and deep integration into media processing pipelines make it highly exploitable for remote attacks.
items.reason_zh: Windows Media Foundation 中的基于堆的缓冲区溢出允许基于网络的代码执行。其 9.8 的 CVSS 评分以及与媒体处理流水线的深度集成，使其极易被用于远程攻击。

items.reason_en: Integer overflow in Microsoft Color Management enables network RCE. Widespread use in display rendering and color profiling increases the attack surface for remote exploitation.
items.reason_zh: Microsoft Color Management 中的整数溢出可导致网络远程代码执行（RCE）。该组件在显示渲染和色彩配置文件中广泛使用，增加了远程利用的攻击面。

items.reason_en: Relative path traversal in Windows Print Spooler Components allows network privilege escalation. Print Spooler remains a historically critical component frequently targeted for lateral movement and initial access.
items.reason_zh: Windows Print Spooler Components 中的相对路径遍历漏洞可导致网络权限提升。Print Spooler 历来是关键组件，常被用于横向移动和初始访问攻击。

items.reason_en: Heap-based buffer overflow in LSASS allows local privilege escalation. Compromising this service directly threatens credential storage, password hashing, and domain authentication mechanisms.
items.reason_zh: LSASS 中的基于堆的缓冲区溢出可导致本地权限提升。攻破该服务将直接威胁凭据存储、密码哈希及域认证机制。

items.reason_en: Use-after-free in Microsoft Office Word allows local code execution. High relevance for phishing campaigns leveraging malicious documents, macros, and rich content parsing.
items.reason_zh: Microsoft Office Word 中的释放后使用漏洞可导致本地代码执行。该漏洞与利用恶意文档、宏及富文本内容解析的网络钓鱼活动高度相关。

items.reason_en: Critical use-after-free in the Virtual Filtering Platform allows unauthenticated remote code execution, posing a severe threat to endpoint security.
items.reason_zh: Virtual Filtering Platform 中的严重释放后使用漏洞可导致无需身份验证的远程代码执行，对端点安全构成严重威胁。

items.reason_en: High-severity out-of-bounds read in the DHCP Server enables unauthenticated remote code execution, directly compromising network infrastructure.
items.reason_zh: DHCP Server 中的高危越界读取漏洞可导致无需身份验证的远程代码执行，直接破坏网络基础设施。

items.reason_en: Invalid pointer release in the iSCSI component allows unauthenticated remote code execution, risking storage network integrity.
items.reason_zh: iSCSI 组件中的无效指针释放漏洞可导致无需身份验证的远程代码执行，危及存储网络的完整性。

items.reason_en: Imaging Component heap overflow allows remote code execution through malicious image processing, threatening user workstations.
items.reason_zh: Imaging Component 中的堆溢出漏洞可通过恶意图像处理实现远程代码执行，威胁用户工作站安全。

items.reason_en: Performance Counters heap overflow enables remote code execution, impacting system telemetry and stability.
items.reason_zh: Performance Counters 堆溢出漏洞可导致远程代码执行，影响系统遥测数据收集与稳定性。

items.reason_en: HID Parser integer underflow allows privilege escalation over the network, compromising peripheral interaction security.
items.reason_zh: HID Parser 中的整数下溢漏洞可导致通过网络进行权限提升，破坏外设交互安全性。

items.reason_en: eSCL Scanner service flaw allows remote code execution, posing significant risks to networked printing environments.
items.reason_zh: eSCL Scanner 服务缺陷可导致远程代码执行，对网络化打印环境构成重大风险。

items.reason_en: Media Player heap overflow enables remote code execution, endangering users who open crafted multimedia files.
items.reason_zh: Media Player 堆溢出漏洞可导致远程代码执行，危害打开构造的多媒体文件的用户。

items.reason_en: Double free in DirectMusic allows unauthorized remote code execution over the network, posing a critical threat to Windows workstations.
items.reason_zh: DirectMusic 中的双重释放漏洞可导致未经授权的远程代码执行，对 Windows 工作站构成关键威胁。

items.reason_en: Stack-based buffer overflow in DirectMusic enables remote code execution, directly compromising user systems via malicious audio inputs.
items.reason_zh: DirectMusic 中的基于栈的缓冲区溢出漏洞可导致远程代码执行，通过恶意音频输入直接破坏用户系统。

items.reason_en: Integer underflow in the Windows Codecs Library allows remote attackers to execute arbitrary code by processing malformed image files, affecting a broad user base.
items.reason_zh: Windows Codecs Library 中的整数下溢漏洞允许远程攻击者通过处理畸形图像文件执行任意代码，影响广泛的用户群体。

items.reason_en: Visual Studio Code fails to restrict rendered UI layers, allowing unauthorized local attackers to bypass security features and potentially escalate privileges.
items.reason_zh: Visual Studio Code 未能限制渲染的 UI 图层，导致未经授权的本地攻击者可绕过安全功能并可能提升权限。

items.reason_en: Parallels Desktop local privilege escalation allows guest VMs to compromise host macOS systems, breaking virtualization boundaries.
items.reason_zh: Parallels Desktop 的本地权限提升漏洞允许客户机虚拟机（VM）攻破宿主机 macOS 系统，破坏虚拟化边界。

items.reason_en: ASUS GPU Tweak III OS command injection enables remote attackers to execute arbitrary commands on workstations, impacting system stability and security.
items.reason_zh: ASUS GPU Tweak III 的系统命令注入漏洞使远程攻击者能够在工作站上执行任意命令，影响系统稳定性与安全性。

items.reason_en: Soda PDF Desktop use-after-free vulnerability allows remote code execution when processing malicious documents, targeting end-user productivity suites.
items.reason_zh: Soda PDF Desktop 的释放后使用漏洞在处理恶意文档时可导致远程代码执行，主要面向终端用户办公套件。

items.reason_en: Local privilege escalation in Parallels Desktop allows low-privileged attackers to gain elevated access on macOS hosts, compromising virtualized environments.
items.reason_zh: Parallels Desktop 中的本地权限提升漏洞允许低权限攻击者在 macOS 宿主机上获取高权限访问，破坏虚拟化环境。

items.reason_en: Heap memory corruption in FFmpeg's dynaudnorm filter can be triggered by malicious scripts, potentially leading to arbitrary code execution or application crashes.
items.reason_zh: FFmpeg 的 dynaudnorm 过滤器中的堆内存损坏可由恶意脚本触发，可能导致任意代码执行或应用程序崩溃。

items.reason_en: Allows low-privileged users to execute arbitrary commands with LocalSystem privileges on Windows endpoints, severely compromising host security.
items.reason_zh: 该漏洞允许低权限用户在 Windows 终端上使用 LocalSystem 权限执行任意命令，严重破坏主机安全性。

items.reason_en: Custom URL scheme handler in Dell Alienware Command Center enables remote command execution and phishing attacks targeting desktop users.
items.reason_zh: Dell Alienware Command Center 中的自定义 URL 方案处理器可导致远程命令执行，并针对桌面用户发起网络钓鱼攻击。

items.reason_en: ZoneAlarm client flaw permits local users to escalate privileges to SYSTEM level, bypassing standard Windows security boundaries.
items.reason_zh: ZoneAlarm 客户端缺陷允许本地用户将权限提升至 SYSTEM 级别，绕过标准 Windows 安全边界。

items.reason_en: DLL search order hijacking in Thermalright TR-VISION HOME allows local attackers to load malicious libraries for privilege escalation.
items.reason_zh: Thermalright TR-VISION HOME 中的 DLL 搜索顺序劫持漏洞允许本地攻击者加载恶意库以实现权限提升。

items.reason_en: Bypasses AMD secure boot authentication via SPI flash access, enabling full platform control and unsigned code execution at the hardware level.
items.reason_zh: 该漏洞通过 SPI Flash 访问绕过 AMD Secure Boot 认证，实现硬件层面的完整平台控制及未签名代码执行。

items.reason_en: Bypasses GNOME Remote Desktop's connection throttler, allowing unauthenticated attackers to flood the service with parallel connections and cause denial of service or resource exhaustion.
items.reason_zh: 该漏洞绕过 GNOME Remote Desktop 的连接限流器，允许未认证攻击者通过并发连接洪水式攻击该服务，导致拒绝服务或资源耗尽。

items.reason_en: Use-after-free in the Linux kernel disk removal handler can trigger kernel panics or privilege escalation during storage detachment.
items.reason_zh: Linux 内核磁盘移除处理程序中的释放后使用漏洞可在存储分离期间触发内核恐慌或权限提升。

items.reason_en: Out-of-bounds read in the SMB client implementation risks local kernel information disclosure and system instability.
items.reason_zh: SMB 客户端实现中的越界读取漏洞存在本地内核信息泄露及系统不稳定的风险。

items.reason_en: Code injection in Microsoft Teams for Android enables network spoofing attacks. This flaw undermines mobile collaboration security and risks credential theft on corporate devices.
items.reason_zh: Android 版 Microsoft Teams 中的代码注入漏洞可导致网络欺骗攻击。该缺陷破坏了移动协作安全性，并危及企业设备上的凭据窃取风险。

items.reason_en: Inadequate encryption strength in Windows Modern Device Management allows remote code execution. Weak cryptographic controls expose mobile fleet management to interception and takeover.
items.reason_zh: Windows Modern Device Management 中加密强度不足可导致远程代码执行。薄弱的加密控制使移动终端管理面临被拦截和接管的风险。

items.reason_en: Origin validation error in Microsoft Teams for Android allows network-based spoofing attacks, potentially compromising user identity and communication integrity.
items.reason_zh: Android版 Microsoft Teams 中的来源验证缺陷允许基于网络的欺骗攻击，可能破坏用户身份和通信完整性。

items.reason_en: ExifTool on Android constructs shell commands from media file paths, enabling command injection via crafted filenames during CSV export.
items.reason_zh: Android上的 ExifTool 会根据媒体文件路径构造Shell命令，在导出CSV时可通过精心构造的文件名实现命令注入。

items.reason_en: PingTools Network Utilities app executes attacker-controlled host values directly in system ping commands, allowing local command injection.
items.reason_zh: PingTools Network Utilities 应用在系统ping命令中直接执行攻击者控制的Host值，导致本地命令注入。

items.reason_en: Exposes internal web administration APIs over public IPv6 interfaces without firewall protection, granting remote attackers unrestricted access to device management functions.
items.reason_zh: 该漏洞在未受防火墙保护的公网IPv6接口上暴露了内部Web管理API，使远程攻击者能够无限制访问设备管理功能。

items.reason_en: Allows any application to send arbitrary AT commands to the cellular modem without permissions, enabling IMEI/IMSI theft and SMS manipulation.
items.reason_zh: 该漏洞允许任何应用在无需权限的情况下向蜂窝调制解调器发送任意AT指令，从而导致IMEI/IMSI被窃取及短信被篡改。

items.reason_en: Attacker-controlled out-of-bounds stack write in MCUboot's encrypted recovery path compromises firmware integrity and enables remote code execution on constrained embedded devices.
items.reason_zh: MCUboot 加密恢复路径中存在攻击者可控的栈越界写入漏洞，会破坏固件完整性并在资源受限的嵌入式设备上实现远程代码执行。

items.reason_en: Disabled assertions in production builds allow MCUboot to silently bypass critical security invariants, potentially permitting malicious or corrupted images to be installed.
items.reason_zh: 生产构建版本中禁用的断言检查使 MCUboot 能够静默绕过关键安全校验，可能导致恶意或损坏的镜像被安装。

items.reason_en: Heap-based buffer overflow in the Xbox system driver permits unauthorized remote code execution over the network, severely impacting gaming console and embedded device security.
items.reason_zh: Xbox系统驱动中存在基于堆的缓冲区溢出漏洞，允许通过网络进行未授权的远程代码执行，严重威胁游戏主机及嵌入式设备的安全。

items.reason_en: Lantronix S2220 shell restriction bypass allows authenticated attackers to execute arbitrary OS commands on industrial IoT gateways.
items.reason_zh: Lantronix S2220 存在Shell限制绕过漏洞，允许已认证的攻击者在工业物联网网关上执行任意操作系统命令。

items.reason_en: Acer endpoints expose unauthenticated WiFi-accessible APIs, enabling immediate remote reconnaissance and configuration manipulation on connected devices.
items.reason_zh: Acer 终端设备暴露了无需认证即可通过WiFi访问的API，使攻击者能够对已连接设备进行即时远程侦察和配置篡改。

items.reason_en: BusyBox tftpd path traversal permits unauthenticated attackers to read sensitive system files on embedded routers and network appliances.
items.reason_zh: BusyBox tftpd 存在路径遍历漏洞，允许未认证的攻击者读取嵌入式路由器和网络设备上的敏感系统文件。

items.reason_en: Unauthenticated HTTP DELETE endpoint on Acer WiFi clients allows permanent deletion of meeting recordings, severely impacting device availability and user trust.
items.reason_zh: Acer WiFi客户端上存在未认证的HTTP DELETE端点，可导致会议录音被永久删除，严重影响设备可用性与用户信任。

items.reason_en: Multiple flaws in D-Link Bluetooth management functions could enable unauthorized configuration changes or device pairing manipulation on connected smart home hardware.
items.reason_zh: D-Link 蓝牙管理功能存在多个缺陷，可能导致已连接的智能家居硬件遭受未授权配置更改或设备配对操控。

items.reason_en: Synology DSM OAuth API fails to neutralize argument delimiters, allowing remote attackers to read/write arbitrary files and trigger denial of service.
items.reason_zh: Synology DSM OAuth API 未能正确过滤参数分隔符，允许远程攻击者读写任意文件并触发拒绝服务攻击。

items.reason_en: Publicly available exploit targets D-Link DIR-X1860 router firmware, enabling remote operating system command injection.
items.reason_zh: 针对 D-Link DIR-X1860 路由器固件的公开漏洞利用代码可实现远程操作系统命令注入。

items.reason_en: Permits authenticated administrators to inject shell metacharacters into iSCSI LUN names, resulting in arbitrary root-level command execution via cron jobs.
items.reason_zh: 该漏洞允许已认证管理员将Shell元字符注入iSCSI LUN名称中，进而通过cron作业实现任意root级命令执行。

items.reason_en: Disables proper TLS certificate validation during firmware updates, allowing man-in-the-middle attackers to impersonate update servers and push malicious payloads.
items.reason_zh: 固件更新过程中禁用了正确的TLS证书验证，使中间人攻击者能够伪装成更新服务器并推送恶意载荷。

items.reason_en: Weak challenge parameter validation in TP-Link Tapo cameras allows local network attackers to bypass authentication and steal administrative session tokens.
items.reason_zh: TP-Link Tapo 摄像头存在挑战参数验证薄弱问题，允许局域网攻击者绕过认证并窃取管理员会话令牌。

items.reason_en: Malformed wildcard subscription handling in aMQTT triggers regex backtracking, enabling unauthenticated denial of service in IoT messaging brokers.
items.reason_zh: aMQTT 对畸形通配符订阅的处理不当会触发正则表达式回溯，导致物联网消息代理出现未认证的拒绝服务漏洞。

items.reason_en: Authentication bypass in Genetec Security Center's OIDC/SAML integration allows unauthorized actors to access critical surveillance and physical access control systems.
items.reason_zh: Genetec Security Center 的 OIDC/SAML 集成存在认证绕过漏洞，使未授权实体能够访问关键监控系统及物理访问控制系统。

items.reason_en: Incorrect authorization in Active Directory Domain Services enables privilege escalation over the network, jeopardizing core enterprise identity and access management infrastructure.
items.reason_zh: Active Directory Domain Services 中存在权限校验缺陷，可导致网络权限提升，危及企业核心身份与访问管理基础设施。

items.reason_en: Critical authentication failure in Azure Event Grid grants unauthenticated attackers elevated privileges, potentially disrupting event-driven architectures across tenants.
items.reason_zh: Azure Event Grid 存在严重认证失败漏洞，可使未认证攻击者获取高权限，进而可能破坏跨租户的事件驱动架构。

items.reason_en: Special element injection flaw in Azure App Service allows unauthenticated privilege escalation, undermining containerized application security boundaries.
items.reason_zh: Azure App Service 存在特殊元素注入缺陷，可导致未认证权限提升，破坏容器化应用的安全边界。

items.reason_en: SSRF vulnerability in Azure Machine Learning enables authorized users to pivot internally and escalate privileges, exposing sensitive model training environments.
items.reason_zh: Azure Machine Learning 存在SSRF漏洞，允许已授权用户在内网进行横向移动并提权，从而暴露敏感的模型训练环境。

items.reason_en: With a perfect CVSS score of 10.0, this authorization bypass in Entra Device Registration allows network privilege escalation, directly compromising identity and device management infrastructure.
items.reason_zh: Entra Device Registration 中的授权绕过漏洞CVSS评分达10.0（满分），可导致网络权限提升，直接危及身份与设备管理基础设施。

items.reason_en: Missing authentication in Azure OpenAI enables network privilege escalation, exposing AI service deployments to unauthorized control and potential tenant data exfiltration.
items.reason_zh: Azure OpenAI 存在缺失认证机制漏洞，可导致网络权限提升，使AI服务部署面临未授权控制及潜在的租户数据泄露风险。

items.reason_en: Incorrect authorization in Microsoft Graph allows network privilege escalation, undermining the core API gateway that secures cross-service interactions across Microsoft 365 ecosystems.
items.reason_zh: Microsoft Graph 中存在授权缺陷，可导致网络权限提升，破坏了保障 Microsoft 365 生态系统跨服务交互的核心API网关安全。

items.reason_en: Improper privilege management in Azure Kubernetes Service permits local privilege escalation, threatening container orchestration security and multi-tenant workload isolation.
items.reason_zh: Azure Kubernetes Service 存在权限管理不当漏洞，可导致本地权限提升，威胁容器编排安全及多租户工作负载隔离。

items.reason_en: Server-side request forgery in Azure Managed Grafana allows unauthorized privilege escalation with a CVSS of 9.8. This directly threatens cloud monitoring infrastructure and multi-tenant isolation.
items.reason_zh: Azure Managed Grafana 存在服务端请求伪造（SSRF）漏洞，CVSS评分为9.8，可导致未授权权限提升，直接威胁云监控基础设施及多租户隔离安全。

items.reason_en: Incorrect permission assignment in Azure Front Door enables network privilege escalation. Misconfigured edge routing services risk unauthorized access to downstream cloud resources.
items.reason_zh: Azure Front Door 权限分配错误可导致网络提权。边缘路由服务配置不当可能引发对下游云资源的未授权访问。

items.reason_en: Path traversal in Azure CycleCloud allows network information disclosure. Affects cloud workload orchestration and could expose sensitive configuration, credentials, or tenant data.
items.reason_zh: Azure CycleCloud 路径遍历漏洞可导致网络信息泄露。该漏洞影响云工作负载编排，可能暴露敏感配置、凭据或租户数据。

items.reason_en: Authorization bypass in Azure DevOps Server allows privilege escalation over the network, threatening CI/CD pipelines and source code repositories.
items.reason_zh: Azure DevOps Server 授权绕过漏洞允许通过网络进行权限提升，威胁 CI/CD 流水线及源代码仓库。

items.reason_en: Improper authentication in Azure DevOps allows remote attackers to execute code over the network, jeopardizing CI/CD pipelines and sensitive repository data.
items.reason_zh: Azure DevOps 身份验证缺陷允许远程攻击者通过网络执行代码，危及 CI/CD 流水线及敏感仓库数据。

items.reason_en: OS command injection in Azure CycleCloud enables authenticated attackers to elevate privileges and execute arbitrary commands across cloud-managed clusters.
items.reason_zh: Azure CycleCloud 操作系统命令注入漏洞使已认证攻击者能够提升权限并在云管理集群中执行任意命令。

items.reason_en: KubeVirt improper symlink validation allows namespace-restricted users to escape to the host filesystem, critically undermining Kubernetes isolation.
items.reason_zh: KubeVirt 符号链接验证不当允许受命名空间限制的用户逃逸至宿主机文件系统，严重破坏 Kubernetes 隔离机制。

items.reason_en: AWS SSM Agent default cryptographic key usage enables local privilege escalation, compromising instance security across AWS environments.
items.reason_zh: AWS SSM Agent 默认使用加密密钥可导致本地权限提升，损害跨 AWS 环境的实例安全性。

items.reason_en: HPE Morpheus Manager arbitrary remote code execution allows attackers to fully compromise hybrid cloud orchestration infrastructure.
items.reason_zh: HPE Morpheus Manager 任意远程代码执行漏洞使攻击者能够完全控制混合云编排基础设施。

items.reason_en: Hardcoded default JWT verification keys in AutoGPT Platform compromise authentication integrity, allowing attackers to forge tokens and bypass security controls.
items.reason_zh: AutoGPT Platform 硬编码的默认 JWT 验证密钥破坏了身份验证完整性，使攻击者能够伪造令牌并绕过安全控制。

items.reason_en: Authentication bypass in Pomerium's MCP token endpoint skips client secret verification, enabling unauthorized access using intercepted authorization codes.
items.reason_zh: Pomerium 的 MCP 令牌端点存在身份验证绕过漏洞，跳过了客户端密钥验证，使攻击者能够利用截获的授权码实现未授权访问。

items.reason_en: Actively exploited deserialization flaw in Hex.pm package registry parser allows unauthenticated remote code execution, posing severe supply chain risks.
items.reason_zh: Hex.pm 软件包注册表解析器中存在被主动利用的反序列化缺陷，允许未认证远程代码执行，带来严重的供应链风险。

items.reason_en: CISA KEV-listed vulnerability allows authenticated API users to bypass LDAP sync restrictions, enabling internal network reconnaissance.
items.reason_zh: 列入 CISA KEV 目录的漏洞允许已认证的 API 用户绕过 LDAP 同步限制，从而进行内部网络侦察。

items.reason_en: Buildah/Podman flaw permits container builds to mount arbitrary host filesystem locations, completely breaking container isolation guarantees.
items.reason_zh: Buildah/Podman 缺陷允许容器构建过程挂载任意宿主机文件系统位置，彻底破坏容器隔离保证。

items.reason_en: Nested compiler expression bypass in Cribl allows authenticated attackers to execute code with Leader service account permissions.
items.reason_zh: Cribl 嵌套编译器表达式绕过漏洞允许已认证攻击者以 Leader 服务账户权限执行代码。

items.reason_en: Fails to set permission checking callbacks for ephemeral containers, allowing attackers to bypass security controls and escalate privileges within containerized environments.
items.reason_zh: 未为临时容器设置权限检查回调，导致攻击者可绕过安全控制并在容器化环境中提权。

items.reason_en: Exploits CRIU's restartable sequence handling during container checkpoint/restore, enabling malicious processes to spoof saved credentials and escape isolation boundaries.
items.reason_zh: 利用 CRIU 在容器检查点/恢复期间的可重启序列处理机制，使恶意进程能够伪造保存的凭据并突破隔离边界。

items.reason_en: Flaw in the containers/image library permits unauthorized authenticated registry access, leading to resource exhaustion and local path traversal in container workflows.
items.reason_zh: containers/image 库缺陷允许利用认证凭证进行未授权注册表访问，导致容器工作流中发生资源耗尽和本地路径遍历。

items.reason_en: Authorization bypass in Cozy Cloud's shared-drive handler allows authenticated users to access and manipulate files belonging to other cloud instances.
items.reason_zh: Cozy Cloud 共享驱动器处理程序存在授权绕过漏洞，允许已认证用户访问并操作属于其他云实例的文件。

items.reason_en: Critical improper authentication flaw in Netis routers allows unauthenticated remote attackers to gain full administrative control, enabling network pivoting and traffic interception.
items.reason_zh: Netis 路由器存在关键性身份验证缺陷，允许未认证远程攻击者获取完全的管理员控制权，从而实现网络跳板与流量拦截。

items.reason_en: Buffer overflow in libslirp's DHCPv6/TFTP builders enables guest-to-host escape and potential host compromise in virtualized and containerized networking stacks.
items.reason_zh: libslirp 的 DHCPv6/TFTP 构建器存在缓冲区溢出漏洞，可在虚拟化与容器化网络栈中实现客端到宿主机的逃逸及潜在的宿主机沦陷。

items.reason_en: Authentication bypass in Windows Kerberos allows network privilege escalation with a CVSS of 9.8. Compromising core directory authentication protocols severely impacts enterprise network security.
items.reason_zh: Windows Kerberos 身份验证绕过漏洞可实现网络提权，CVSS 评分为 9.8。核心目录身份验证协议遭破坏将严重影响企业网络安全。

items.reason_en: Untrusted pointer dereference in DNS Server enables remote code execution over a network. Targeting foundational name resolution services disrupts critical network operations.
items.reason_zh: DNS Server 不受信任指针解引用漏洞可导致网络远程代码执行。针对基础名称解析服务的攻击将破坏关键网络运行。

items.reason_en: Stack-based buffer overflow in Windows Client for NFS allows remote code execution. This exposes network file sharing protocols to immediate exploitation by adjacent attackers.
items.reason_zh: Windows Client for NFS 基于栈的缓冲区溢出漏洞允许远程代码执行。此漏洞使网络文件共享协议面临相邻攻击者的即时利用风险。

items.reason_en: Heap-based buffer overflow in DNS Server allows network code execution. DNS infrastructure is a high-value target for cache poisoning, traffic interception, and service disruption.
items.reason_zh: DNS Server 基于堆的缓冲区溢出漏洞允许网络代码执行。DNS 基础设施是缓存投毒、流量拦截和服务中断的高价值目标。

items.reason_en: Heap-based buffer overflow in DNS Server allows network code execution. Highlights systemic memory corruption risks in core name resolution services running on network appliances.
items.reason_zh: DNS Server 基于堆的缓冲区溢出漏洞允许网络代码执行。凸显了运行在网络设备上的核心名称解析服务存在的系统性内存损坏风险。

items.reason_en: Use-after-free in DNS Server allows network code execution. Exploits memory corruption in network-facing DNS handling, risking full server compromise and routing manipulation.
items.reason_zh: DNS Server 释放后使用漏洞允许网络代码执行。该漏洞利用面向网络的 DNS 处理中的内存损坏，可能导致服务器完全沦陷及路由操纵。

items.reason_en: Integer overflow in Windows SMB Server allows network code execution. SMB vulnerabilities directly enable ransomware propagation, unauthorized file access, and cross-network lateral movement.
items.reason_zh: Windows SMB Server 整数溢出漏洞允许网络代码执行。SMB 漏洞直接助长勒索软件传播、未授权文件访问及跨网络横向移动。

items.reason_en: DNS Server use-after-free allows unauthenticated remote code execution, critical for network resolution infrastructure.
items.reason_zh: DNS Server 释放后使用漏洞可导致未认证远程代码执行，严重威胁网络解析基础设施。

items.reason_en: DNS Server heap overflow enables remote code execution, jeopardizing network name resolution services.
items.reason_zh: DNS Server 堆溢出漏洞可导致远程代码执行，危及网络名称解析服务。

items.reason_en: Double free vulnerability in Windows DNS allows unauthorized remote code execution, threatening core network resolution infrastructure.
items.reason_zh: Windows DNS 双重释放漏洞允许未授权远程代码执行，威胁核心网络解析基础设施。

items.reason_en: Heap-based buffer overflow in the DNS Server service permits remote attackers to execute code over the network, disrupting critical name resolution services.
items.reason_zh: DNS Server 服务中的基于堆的缓冲区溢出漏洞允许远程攻击者通过网络执行代码，破坏关键名称解析服务。

items.reason_en: Volans NGFW SSLVPN OS command injection delivers a critical remote code execution flaw, completely compromising next-generation firewall management.
items.reason_zh: Volans NGFW SSLVPN 操作系统命令注入漏洞导致严重的远程代码执行缺陷，完全破坏了下一代防火墙管理功能。

items.reason_en: F5 NGINX regex variable ordering flaw can cause unexpected behavior or crashes in reverse proxy deployments, impacting web traffic reliability.
items.reason_zh: F5 NGINX 正则表达式变量排序缺陷可能导致反向代理部署中出现意外行为或崩溃，影响 Web 流量可靠性。

items.reason_en: ntop n2n supernode stack-based buffer overflow allows remote code execution and memory leaks in overlay VPN networks.
items.reason_zh: ntop n2n supernode 基于栈的缓冲区溢出漏洞允许在覆盖型 VPN 网络中实现远程代码执行和内存泄漏。

items.reason_en: Remote OS command injection in Panabit Smart Application Gateway allows complete system compromise of network security appliances via crafted email authentication requests.
items.reason_zh: Panabit Smart Application Gateway 中的远程 OS 命令注入漏洞允许通过构造的电子邮件认证请求完全攻陷网络安全设备。

items.reason_en: Flawed signature verification logic in Pion DTLS enables man-in-the-middle attacks and session hijacking in Go-based network services and libraries.
items.reason_zh: Pion DTLS 中缺陷的签名验证逻辑可在基于 Go 的网络服务和库中启用中间人攻击与会话劫持。

items.reason_en: Improper cryptographic signature verification in Erlang OTP SSL enables on-path attackers to impersonate any TLS or DTLS server.
items.reason_zh: Erlang OTP SSL 中不正确的密码学签名验证机制允许路径中间攻击者伪装成任意 TLS 或 DTLS 服务器。

items.reason_en: SQL injection in Fortinet FortiAnalyzer compromises centralized security appliance logging and analytics capabilities.
items.reason_zh: Fortinet FortiAnalyzer 中的 SQL 注入漏洞破坏了集中式安全设备的日志记录与分析能力。

items.reason_en: Out-of-bounds read in FortiOS network firewall allows unauthenticated remote code execution via specially crafted network packets.
items.reason_zh: FortiOS 网络防火墙中的越界读取漏洞允许通过特制的网络数据包在未认证的情况下执行远程代码。

items.reason_en: DHCPv6 relay memory handling issue in dnsmasq enables remote denial of service or potential code execution on network infrastructure.
items.reason_zh: dnsmasq 中 DHCPv6 中继内存处理问题可导致网络基础设施遭受远程拒绝服务或潜在代码执行。

items.reason_en: Enables remote command injection as root via crafted salt minion IDs in Juniper's Session Smart Conductor, directly compromising enterprise network orchestration.
items.reason_zh: 在 Juniper Session Smart Conductor 中，通过构造的 Salt minion ID 可实现以 root 权限进行远程命令注入，直接危及企业网络编排系统。

items.reason_en: DHCPv4 option parser miscalculates buffer lengths, causing heap overreads that can be triggered by malicious DHCP responses to crash or destabilize network daemons.
items.reason_zh: DHCPv4 选项解析器错误计算缓冲区长度，导致堆越界读取，恶意 DHCP 响应可触发该漏洞致使网络守护进程崩溃或不稳定。

items.reason_en: Incorrect authorization in Open5GS WebUI allows authenticated users to escalate privileges, modify accounts, and compromise 5G core infrastructure.
items.reason_zh: Open5GS WebUI 中的授权不正确漏洞允许已认证用户提升权限、修改账户并破坏 5G 核心网基础设施。

items.reason_en: HTTP/1 to HTTP/2 conversion error misprioritizes Host headers, facilitating request smuggling and protocol confusion attacks on network proxies.
items.reason_zh: HTTP/1 到 HTTP/2 转换错误导致 Host 头优先级错乱，助长针对网络代理的请求走私与协议混淆攻击。

items.reason_en: Copeland XWEB Pro OS command injection grants authenticated attackers root-level control over building management controllers, disrupting HVAC operations.
items.reason_zh: Copeland XWEB Pro 操作系统命令注入漏洞使已认证攻击者获得对楼宇管理控制器的 root 级控制权，破坏 HVAC 运行。

items.reason_en: Copeland XWEB Pro missing authentication vulnerability enables unauthorized remote access to critical industrial control interfaces.
items.reason_zh: Copeland XWEB Pro 缺失身份验证漏洞使未经授权的攻击者能够远程访问关键工业控制接口。

items.reason_en: Plain text exposure of access control credentials in Genetec Security Center logs allows local attackers to harvest sensitive authentication data for physical security systems.
items.reason_zh: Genetec Security Center 日志中访问控制凭证明文暴露，允许本地攻击者窃取物理安全系统的敏感认证数据。

items.reason_en: Out-of-bounds write in NVIDIA Jetson Linux kernel modules can lead to privilege escalation and denial of service on edge AI and industrial computing platforms.
items.reason_zh: NVIDIA Jetson Linux 内核模块中的越界写入漏洞可能导致边缘 AI 和工业计算平台发生权限提升与拒绝服务。

items.reason_en: Insufficient restriction of runtime visualization commands in CODESYS allows unauthenticated remote attackers to invoke engineering workstation functionality.
items.reason_zh: CODESYS 中对运行时可视化命令的限制不足，允许未认证远程攻击者调用工程工作站功能。

items.reason_en: Heap buffer overflow in Open Robotics RViz enables network-adjacent attackers to execute arbitrary code without authentication.
items.reason_zh: Open Robotics RViz 中的堆缓冲区溢出漏洞允许网络相邻攻击者在无需认证的情况下执行任意代码。

items.reason_en: Missing server-side authorization in TXOne StellarProtect IPC interface allows local attackers to issue privileged commands without credentials.
items.reason_zh: TXOne StellarProtect IPC 接口中缺失服务端授权，允许本地攻击者在无凭据的情况下下发特权命令。

items.reason_en: Insufficiently restricts visualization data inputs, allowing unauthenticated remote attackers to invoke local COM/ActiveX components and execute code on engineering workstations.
items.reason_zh: 对可视化数据输入的限制不足，允许未认证远程攻击者调用本地 COM/ActiveX 组件并在工程工作站内执行代码。

items.reason_en: Format string vulnerability in Hitachi RTU500 logging functions enables sensitive memory disclosure and denial of service, threatening critical industrial telemetry systems.
items.reason_zh: Hitachi RTU500 日志函数中的格式化字符串漏洞可导致敏感内存泄露与拒绝服务，威胁关键工业遥测系统。

items.reason_en: WAGO web management authorization flaw permits low-privileged remote attackers to modify critical PROFIBUS device parameters, disrupting industrial automation.
items.reason_zh: WAGO Web 管理授权缺陷允许低权限远程攻击者修改关键 PROFIBUS 设备参数，破坏工业自动化运行。

items.reason_en: Deserialization of untrusted data in MediaWiki's Echo extension allows remote code execution, threatening widely deployed wiki and content management platforms.
items.reason_zh: MediaWiki Echo 扩展中不受信任数据的反序列化漏洞允许远程代码执行，威胁广泛部署的 Wiki 和内容管理平台。

items.reason_en: Improper access control in MediaWiki's EditAccount extension permits unauthorized account modifications and privilege escalation across multiple supported versions.
items.reason_zh: MediaWiki EditAccount 扩展中访问控制不当允许未经授权的账户修改与权限提升，影响多个受支持版本。

items.reason_en: Misconfigured CORS filtering in RESTEasy reflects origins with credentials, facilitating cross-origin request forgery against backend APIs and exposing sensitive session data.
items.reason_zh: RESTEasy 中配置错误的 CORS 过滤机制会反射携带凭据的来源，助长针对后端 API 的跨站请求伪造攻击并泄露敏感会话数据。

items.reason_en: High-severity XSS in the Azure Portal facilitates phishing and session hijacking attacks against administrators managing cloud resources.
items.reason_zh: Azure Portal 中的高危 XSS 漏洞助长针对管理云资源管理员的钓鱼与会话劫持攻击。

items.reason_en: XSS flaw in the Authentication Methods Portal Extension allows privilege escalation through crafted web payloads, weakening identity management controls.
items.reason_zh: Authentication Methods Portal Extension 中的 XSS 漏洞允许通过构造的 Web Payload 实现权限提升，削弱身份管理控制。

items.reason_en: Improper authentication in ASP.NET Core exposes backend APIs to unauthorized access, affecting numerous web applications relying on this framework.
items.reason_zh: ASP.NET Core 中身份验证不当导致后端 API 暴露于未授权访问之下，影响众多依赖该框架的 Web 应用。

items.reason_en: Deserialization of untrusted data in Microsoft SharePoint Server allows remote code execution. Insecure deserialization in widely deployed web platforms poses severe backend compromise risks.
items.reason_zh: Microsoft SharePoint Server 中不受信任数据的反序列化可导致远程代码执行。在广泛部署的 Web 平台中存在不安全的反序列化问题，会对后端系统造成严重的受损风险。

items.reason_en: Incorrect authorization in Microsoft SharePoint Server enables privilege escalation over a network. Authentication bypass flaws in enterprise web portals can lead to unauthorized data access.
items.reason_zh: Microsoft SharePoint Server 中的授权错误可允许通过网络提升权限。企业 Web 门户中的身份验证绕过漏洞可能导致未授权的数据访问。

items.reason_en: Improper authorization in Windows Admin Center allows privilege escalation over a network. Weak access controls in centralized management interfaces threaten infrastructure oversight.
items.reason_zh: Windows Admin Center 中的授权不当可允许通过网络提升权限。集中管理界面中薄弱的访问控制会威胁基础设施的管理安全。

items.reason_en: Improper input validation in Microsoft Exchange Server enables network code execution, directly jeopardizing enterprise email infrastructure confidentiality and availability.
items.reason_zh: Microsoft Exchange Server 中输入验证不当可导致网络代码执行，直接危及企业电子邮件基础设施的机密性和可用性。

items.reason_en: Server-side request forgery in Microsoft Office SharePoint allows network privilege escalation, enabling attackers to pivot internally and access restricted backend resources.
items.reason_zh: Microsoft Office SharePoint 中的服务器端请求伪造可导致网络权限提升，使攻击者能够进行横向移动并访问受限的后端资源。

items.reason_en: Resource exhaustion vulnerabilities in ASP.NET Core facilitate network denial-of-service attacks, impacting web application performance and reliability under sustained load.
items.reason_zh: ASP.NET Core 中的资源耗尽漏洞可助长网络拒绝服务攻击，在持续负载下影响 Web 应用的性能和可靠性。

items.reason_en: Cross-site scripting in Microsoft Office SharePoint enables network spoofing, creating viable pathways for credential theft and targeted phishing against enterprise users.
items.reason_zh: Microsoft Office SharePoint 中的跨站脚本漏洞可导致网络欺骗，为凭证窃取和针对企业用户的定向钓鱼攻击提供可行途径。

items.reason_en: Cross-site scripting in Microsoft Office SharePoint allows network privilege escalation with a CVSS of 9.0. High-severity web application flaws directly impact enterprise content management systems.
items.reason_zh: Microsoft Office SharePoint 中的跨站脚本漏洞可导致网络权限提升（CVSS 评分为 9.0）。高危 Web 应用缺陷直接影响企业内容管理系统。

items.reason_en: Deserialization of untrusted data in SharePoint enables remote code execution. This classic web attack vector poses severe risks to hosted business applications and portals.
items.reason_zh: SharePoint 中不受信任数据的反序列化可导致远程代码执行。这种经典的 Web 攻击向量对托管的业务应用和门户构成严重风险。

items.reason_en: Incorrect authorization in ASP.NET Core allows unauthorized privilege escalation over the network, fundamentally breaking web application security controls.
items.reason_zh: ASP.NET Core 中的授权错误可允许未经授权的网络权限提升，从根本上破坏 Web 应用的安全控制机制。

items.reason_en: Uncontrolled resource consumption in ASP.NET Core enables denial-of-service attacks against web servers without requiring authentication.
items.reason_zh: ASP.NET Core 中不受控的资源消耗可导致无需身份验证即可对 Web 服务器发起拒绝服务攻击。

items.reason_en: TOCTOU race condition in the .NET framework can lead to local privilege escalation, affecting cross-platform web and backend deployments.
items.reason_zh: .NET 框架中的 TOCTOU 竞态条件可导致本地权限提升，影响跨平台的 Web 和后端部署。

items.reason_en: Deserialization of untrusted data in Idunno.AntiCsrf allows unauthenticated remote code execution, actively exploited in the wild against ASP.NET applications.
items.reason_zh: Idunno.AntiCsrf 中不受信任数据的反序列化可导致未认证的远程代码执行，该漏洞已在实际环境中被积极利用以攻击 ASP.NET 应用。

items.reason_en: Mishandling of the account signup flow in Optimizely allows attacker-controlled JavaScript injection, actively targeted in production environments.
items.reason_zh: Optimizely 中账户注册流程处理不当可导致攻击者控制的 JavaScript 注入，该漏洞在生产环境中正遭到积极利用。

items.reason_en: Unauthenticated stored cross-site scripting in CubeWP Forms enables persistent script injection via REST endpoints, compromising web application integrity and user sessions.
items.reason_zh: CubeWP Forms 中未认证的存储型跨站脚本漏洞可通过 REST 端点实现持久化脚本注入，破坏 Web 应用完整性及用户会话。

items.reason_en: Adobe Experience Manager code injection vulnerability allows low-privileged attackers to execute arbitrary code, severely impacting enterprise content management.
items.reason_zh: Adobe Experience Manager 的代码注入漏洞允许低权限攻击者执行任意代码，严重影响企业内容管理。

items.reason_en: Thymeleaf restricted expression mode bypass enables unauthenticated attackers to perform forbidden actions in Java-based web applications.
items.reason_zh: Thymeleaf 受限表达式模式绕过可使未认证的攻击者在基于 Java 的 Web 应用中执行禁止的操作。

items.reason_en: WHMCS authenticated client flaw allows reading sensitive configuration files and executing code on hosting management servers.
items.reason_zh: WHMCS 已认证客户端缺陷允许读取敏感配置文件并在主机管理服务器上执行代码。

items.reason_en: Inadequate escaping of media field parameters in Joomla enables remote code execution by manipulating form definitions, directly compromising web application integrity.
items.reason_zh: Joomla 中对媒体字段参数转义不足，通过操纵表单定义可实现远程代码执行，直接破坏 Web 应用完整性。

items.reason_en: Missing authentication in Joomla's web installer allows unauthenticated users to overwrite site configurations and take full administrative control of the application.
items.reason_zh: Joomla Web 安装程序缺少身份验证，允许未认证用户覆盖站点配置并完全接管应用程序的管理权限。

items.reason_en: Cross-site WebSocket hijacking and CSRF in compose-farm due to missing Origin validation allows attackers to abuse unauthenticated web UI shells and execute commands.
items.reason_zh: compose-farm 中因缺少 Origin 验证导致跨站 WebSocket 劫持和 CSRF，攻击者可滥用未认证的 Web UI 外壳并执行命令。

items.reason_en: Multiple popular WordPress plugins contain embedded code execution flaws, widely impacting CMS deployments and backend integrity.
items.reason_zh: 多个流行的 WordPress 插件包含嵌入式代码执行漏洞，广泛影响 CMS 部署及后端完整性。

items.reason_en: Keycloak SAML broker login bypass allows attackers to complete authentication using external IdP responses, undermining identity controls.
items.reason_zh: Keycloak SAML 代理登录绕过允许攻击者使用外部 IdP 响应完成身份验证，削弱身份控制机制。

items.reason_en: ActivityPub profile overwrite in Friendica allows remote actors to hijack user identities and sign malicious social activities.
items.reason_zh: Friendica 中 ActivityPub 个人资料覆盖漏洞允许远程实体劫持用户身份并签署恶意社交活动。

items.reason_en: PHP object injection via unserialized encrypted attributes in rConfig allows authenticated attackers to achieve remote code execution.
items.reason_zh: rConfig 中通过反序列化加密属性导致的 PHP 对象注入漏洞，允许已认证攻击者实现远程代码执行。

items.reason_en: Marked in CISA KEV; improperly reset global state causes request memory corruption, leading to unpredictable branching and potential remote code execution across PHP deployments.
items.reason_zh: 列入 CISA KEV；全局状态重置不当会导致请求内存损坏，引发不可预测的分支跳转，并在 PHP 部署中可能导致远程代码执行。

items.reason_en: Marked in CISA KEV; flawed out-of-memory error handling leaves memory uninitialized, allowing subsequent requests to exploit corrupted state for code execution.
items.reason_zh: 列入 CISA KEV；有缺陷的内存不足错误处理会导致内存未初始化，使后续请求可利用损坏的状态执行代码。

items.reason_en: Symfony's stimulus bridge loader executes arbitrary scripts via package.json exports during webpack compilation, enabling remote code execution in affected web applications.
items.reason_zh: Symfony 的 stimulus bridge loader 在 webpack 编译期间通过 package.json 导出执行任意脚本，导致受影响的 Web 应用发生远程代码执行。

items.reason_en: Inefficient algorithmic complexity in Elixir Plug's query string parser enables unauthenticated remote denial of service via crafted request bodies.
items.reason_zh: Elixir Plug 查询字符串解析器存在算法复杂度低效问题，可通过构造的请求体实现未认证的远程拒绝服务攻击。

items.reason_en: Missing record-level authorization in Frappe ERPNext endpoints allows low-privilege users to access sensitive enterprise data beyond their assigned roles.
items.reason_zh: Frappe ERPNext 端点缺少记录级授权，允许低权限用户访问超出其角色范围的敏感企业数据。

items.reason_en: Blind SQL injection in the JoomUnited WP Media Folder plugin compromises WordPress databases by executing unauthorized queries without error feedback.
items.reason_zh: JoomUnited WP Media Folder 插件中的盲SQL注入可通过执行无错误反馈的未授权查询，导致WordPress数据库受损。

items.reason_en: Plaintext byte retention during LDAP StartTLS negotiation in 389-ds-base allows on-path message injection and authentication bypass, undermining directory service security.
items.reason_zh: 389-ds-base 在 LDAP StartTLS 协商过程中保留明文字节，允许路径中消息注入和身份验证绕过，破坏目录服务安全性。

items.reason_en: IIOP authentication bypass in WildFly enables pre-authenticated attackers to invoke EJB methods without transport-level verification, leading to unauthorized business logic execution.
items.reason_zh: WildFly 中的 IIOP 身份验证绕过使已预认证的攻击者能够在无需传输层验证的情况下调用 EJB 方法，导致未授权的业务逻辑执行。

items.reason_en: SQL injection in Microsoft SQL Server allows authorized users to escalate privileges and exfiltrate sensitive database contents over the network.
items.reason_zh: Microsoft SQL Server 中的 SQL 注入漏洞允许授权用户提升权限并通过网络外泄敏感数据库内容。

items.reason_en: Heap-based buffer overflow enables unauthenticated remote code execution in SQL Server, directly threatening database integrity and confidentiality.
items.reason_zh: SQL Server 中的基于堆的缓冲区溢出可启用未认证的远程代码执行，直接威胁数据库的完整性和机密性。

items.reason_en: SQL injection flaw allows authenticated attackers to escalate privileges and manipulate database structures, compromising enterprise data workflows.
items.reason_zh: SQL 注入缺陷允许已认证的攻击者提升权限并操纵数据库结构，从而破坏企业数据工作流。

items.reason_en: OS command injection in Azure Managed Instance for Apache Cassandra permits unauthorized code execution on adjacent networks, risking cloud-native data pipelines.
items.reason_zh: Apache Cassandra 的 Azure 托管实例中的操作系统命令注入漏洞允许在未授权的网络上执行代码，危及云原生数据管道。

items.reason_en: Exposed dangerous methods in SQL Server allow network privilege escalation, risking direct compromise of database engines that store and manage critical organizational data.
items.reason_zh: SQL Server 中暴露的危险方法可导致网络权限提升，存在数据库引擎被直接攻破的风险，这些引擎负责存储和管理关键组织数据。

items.reason_en: Authorization bypass in Microsoft Exchange Server facilitates network privilege escalation, weakening middleware controls essential for secure communication platform operations.
items.reason_zh: Microsoft Exchange Server 中的授权绕过助长了网络权限提升，削弱了安全通信平台运行所必需的中间件控制措施。

items.reason_en: Inefficient algorithmic complexity in the .NET runtime enables network denial-of-service, affecting the underlying middleware layer supporting enterprise-scale applications.
items.reason_zh: .NET 运行时中低效的算法复杂度可导致网络拒绝服务攻击，影响支持企业级应用的底层中间件层。

items.reason_en: Improper cryptographic signature verification in the JDBC Driver for SQL Server allows security feature bypass. This undermines database connectivity security and integrity checks.
items.reason_zh: SQL Server JDBC 驱动程序中的密码学签名验证不当可导致安全功能绕过，破坏数据库连接安全性和完整性检查。

items.reason_en: Heap-based buffer overflow in the WDAC OLE DB provider for SQL enables remote code execution. Compromising the database driver layer threatens data integrity across enterprise systems.
items.reason_zh: SQL 的 WDAC OLE DB 提供程序中的基于堆的缓冲区溢出可启用远程代码执行。数据库驱动层的沦陷将威胁企业系统的数据完整性。

items.reason_en: Stack-based buffer overflow in SQL Server allows network privilege escalation. Directly impacts database integrity, confidentiality, and availability in enterprise environments.
items.reason_zh: SQL Server 中的基于栈的缓冲区溢出可导致网络权限提升，直接影响企业环境中的数据库完整性、机密性和可用性。

items.reason_en: Heap-based buffer overflow in SQL Server allows network code execution. Enables attackers to bypass security controls, extract sensitive data, and execute arbitrary commands on database hosts.
items.reason_zh: SQL Server 中的基于堆的缓冲区溢出可导致网络代码执行，使攻击者能够绕过安全控制、提取敏感数据并在数据库主机上执行任意命令。

items.reason_en: SQL Server heap overflow allows remote code execution, directly compromising database integrity and confidentiality.
items.reason_zh: SQL Server 堆溢出漏洞可导致远程代码执行，直接破坏数据库的完整性和机密性。

items.reason_en: Heap-based buffer overflow in SQL Server facilitates remote code execution, risking full database compromise.
items.reason_zh: SQL Server 中的基于堆的缓冲区溢出可促成远程代码执行，面临数据库完全沦陷的风险。

items.reason_en: Heap-based buffer overflow in SQL Server allows remote code execution, highlighting persistent risks in database engine components.
items.reason_zh: SQL Server 中的基于堆的缓冲区溢出可导致远程代码执行，凸显了数据库引擎组件中持续存在的风险。

items.reason_en: SQL Server heap overflow allows remote code execution, underscoring the need for rigorous input validation in database services.
items.reason_zh: SQL Server 堆溢出漏洞可导致远程代码执行，强调了数据库服务中严格进行输入验证的必要性。

items.reason_en: Out-of-bounds read in SQL Server enables remote privilege escalation, potentially exposing sensitive query data.
items.reason_zh: SQL Server 中的越界读取漏洞可导致远程权限提升，可能暴露敏感的查询数据。

items.reason_en: Untrusted pointer dereference in SQL Server allows remote privilege escalation, undermining database access controls.
items.reason_zh: SQL Server 中的不受信任指针解引用漏洞可导致远程权限提升，破坏数据库访问控制。

items.reason_en: Heap-based buffer overflow in SQL Server allows authorized attackers to execute code over the network, risking full database compromise and data exfiltration.
items.reason_zh: SQL Server 中的基于堆的缓冲区溢出允许授权攻击者通过网络执行代码，面临数据库完全沦陷和数据外泄的风险。

items.reason_en: Heap-based buffer overflow in SQL Server enables remote code execution, directly threatening enterprise data storage and processing services.
items.reason_zh: SQL Server 中的基于堆的缓冲区溢出可启用远程代码执行，直接威胁企业数据存储和处理服务。

items.reason_en: Apache Jena Fuseki SSRF via SHACL validation allows attackers to probe internal networks and access restricted resources in RDF triplestores.
items.reason_zh: Apache Jena Fuseki 通过 SHACL 验证引发的 SSRF 漏洞使攻击者能够探测内部网络并访问 RDF 三元组存储中的受限资源。

items.reason_en: Bytebase DBHub authentication bypass permits unauthenticated remote access to database hubs, exposing sensitive schema and query data.
items.reason_zh: Bytebase DBHub 的身份验证绕过漏洞允许未经认证的远程访问数据库中心，暴露敏感的架构和查询数据。

items.reason_en: Elasticsearch transport decompression buffer over-read exposes memory from other requests, risking data leakage in search clusters.
items.reason_zh: Elasticsearch 传输层解压过程中的缓冲区越界读取会暴露其他请求的内存，导致搜索集群中的数据泄露风险。

items.reason_en: Stack-based buffer overflow in AWS pgactive replication parsing allows authenticated users to execute arbitrary commands as the database operating system user.
items.reason_zh: AWS pgactive 复制解析中的基于栈的缓冲区溢出漏洞允许已认证用户以数据库操作系统用户身份执行任意命令。

items.reason_en: Type confusion vulnerability in SolarWinds Serv-U enables domain administrators to escalate privileges to system level, compromising critical file transfer infrastructure.
items.reason_zh: SolarWinds Serv-U 中的类型混淆漏洞使域管理员能够将权限提升至系统级别，从而破坏关键的文件传输基础设施。

items.reason_en: Unsafe handling of NumPy bytes scalars in PyTables triggers arbitrary Python code execution via pickle deserialization when accessing dataset attributes.
items.reason_zh: PyTables 中对 NumPy 字节标量的不安全处理会在访问数据集属性时通过 pickle 反序列化触发任意 Python 代码执行。

items.reason_en: SpEL expression injection in Spring Data Elasticsearch @Query methods allows attackers to execute arbitrary expressions within database queries.
items.reason_zh: Spring Data Elasticsearch 的 @Query 方法中的 SpEL 表达式注入漏洞使攻击者能够在数据库查询中执行任意表达式。

items.reason_en: Apache Solr ping endpoint privilege escalation bypasses rule-based authorization, enabling unauthorized actions under low-privilege accounts.
items.reason_zh: Apache Solr ping 端点的权限提升漏洞绕过了基于规则的授权机制，使低权限账户能够执行未授权操作。

items.reason_en: Recursive JSONPath size-changing operations in Valkey trigger unsafe reallocation bugs, risking memory corruption in key-value stores.
items.reason_zh: Valkey 中的递归 JSONPath 尺寸更改操作会触发不安全的重新分配漏洞，可能导致键值存储中的内存损坏。

items.reason_en: Incorrect filter translation in Spring Typesense integration alters query semantics, potentially exposing unintended data or bypassing access controls.
items.reason_zh: Spring Typesense 集成中的过滤器翻译错误会改变查询语义，可能导致意外数据泄露或绕过访问控制。

items.reason_en: Improper input validation in Apache Jena ARQ allows malicious SPARQL queries to exhaust CPU and memory resources, disrupting data querying services.
items.reason_zh: Apache Jena ARQ 中的输入验证不当允许恶意 SPARQL 查询耗尽 CPU 和内存资源，破坏数据查询服务。

items.reason_en: Ruby interpreter susceptibility to the Marvin Attack enables cryptographic signature forgery and decryption of previously encrypted messages, compromising data integrity.
items.reason_zh: Ruby 解释器易受 Marvin Attack 影响，可导致加密签名伪造及已加密消息的解密，损害数据完整性。
