items.reason_en: Recursive entity expansion in libexpat triggers stack exhaustion when parsing deeply nested XML documents, causing application crashes and denial of service.
items.reason_zh: libexpat 中的递归实体扩展在解析深层嵌套的 XML 文档时会引发栈耗尽，导致应用程序崩溃和服务拒绝。

items.reason_en: SurrealDB cascade delete bypass allows authenticated users to circumvent table permissions and execute custom expressions on referenced records.
items.reason_zh: SurrealDB 级联删除绕过漏洞允许已认证用户规避表权限，并在引用记录上执行自定义表达式。

items.reason_en: DBHub read-only mode bypass enables MCP clients to execute destructive write and DDL statements, threatening database integrity and compliance.
items.reason_zh: DBHub 只读模式绕过漏洞使 MCP 客户端能够执行破坏性写入和 DDL 语句，威胁数据库完整性与合规性。

items.reason_en: Credential leakage in AutoGPT's MCP tool block allows shared agent authors to misuse user API keys, introducing significant supply-chain risks to AI workflow automation.
items.reason_zh: AutoGPT 的 MCP 工具块中存在凭据泄露问题，允许共享代理作者滥用用户 API 密钥，为 AI 工作流自动化引入严重的供应链风险。

items.reason_en: Path restriction flaw in VeraCrypt's elevated CoreService enables unauthorized file ownership changes, bypassing intended sandbox boundaries on Linux systems.
items.reason_zh: VeraCrypt 提权后的 CoreService 存在路径限制缺陷，可未经授权更改文件所有权，从而绕过 Linux 系统上的预期沙箱边界。

items.reason_en: Integer overflow in libstdc++'s aligned operator new can cause undersized allocations and memory corruption during large-scale C++ processing, destabilizing dependent applications.
items.reason_zh: libstdc++ 的 aligned operator new 存在整数溢出漏洞，在大规模 C++ 处理过程中可能导致分配空间不足和内存损坏，进而破坏依赖应用的稳定性。

items.reason_en: UI misrepresentation of critical information in Visual Studio Code allows security feature bypass over a network. Developer tool vulnerabilities can undermine secure coding practices and CI/CD pipeline integrity.
items.reason_zh: Visual Studio Code 中关键信息的 UI 误显示允许通过网络绕过安全功能。开发者工具漏洞可能破坏安全编码实践及 CI/CD 管道的完整性。

items.reason_en: Deserialization of untrusted data in Visual Studio allows remote code execution, threatening development environments and software supply chain workflows.
items.reason_zh: Visual Studio 中对不受信任数据的反序列化可导致远程代码执行，威胁开发环境及软件供应链工作流。

items.reason_en: Integer overflow in Microsoft JScript allows network code execution. Impacts legacy script execution environments and web application backends still relying on Active Scripting engines.
items.reason_zh: Microsoft JScript 中的整数溢出漏洞允许网络代码执行。主要影响仍依赖 Active Scripting 引擎的传统脚本执行环境及 Web 应用后端。

items.reason_en: Integer underflow in Windows Bluetooth Port Driver allows network privilege escalation. Highlights risks in wireless peripheral stacks that can be abused for local system takeover via proximity attacks.
items.reason_zh: Windows Bluetooth Port Driver 中的整数下溢漏洞允许网络提权。凸显了无线外设堆栈的风险，攻击者可利用邻近攻击滥用该漏洞接管本地系统。

items.reason_en: Untrusted search path in Visual Studio Code allows remote code execution, compromising developer workstations and build environments.
items.reason_zh: Visual Studio Code 中的不受信任搜索路径漏洞可导致远程代码执行，危及开发人员工作站及构建环境。

items.reason_en: Workflow automation flaw in AutoGPT allows users to hijack other users' marketplace listings, introducing significant risks to AI agent orchestration platforms.
items.reason_zh: AutoGPT 的工作流自动化缺陷允许用户劫持其他用户的市场列表，为 AI 代理编排平台引入重大风险。

items.reason_en: Pass-through endpoint code injection in LiteLLM allows authenticated attackers to execute arbitrary commands, highlighting emerging threats in AI proxy middleware.
items.reason_zh: LiteLLM 中的透传端点代码注入漏洞允许已认证攻击者执行任意命令，凸显了 AI 代理中间件中的新兴威胁。

items.reason_en: Dell PowerStore OS command injection allows limited users to escalate to root, compromising enterprise storage appliance integrity.
items.reason_zh: Dell PowerStore 操作系统命令注入漏洞允许受限用户提权至 root，破坏企业存储设备的完整性。

items.reason_en: Tanium Engage command injection enables attackers to execute arbitrary system commands with elevated privileges across managed endpoints.
items.reason_zh: Tanium Engage 命令注入漏洞使攻击者能够在受管终端上以高权限执行任意系统命令。

items.reason_en: DeepSpeed deserialization of untrusted data allows remote code execution when loading malicious AI training checkpoints.
items.reason_zh: DeepSpeed 对不受信任数据的反序列化漏洞在加载恶意 AI 训练检查点时可导致远程代码执行。

items.reason_en: Synchronous TLS handshake without a deadline in Red Hat flightctl allows unauthenticated clients to stall connections and cause a denial of service against the management service.
items.reason_zh: Red Hat flightctl 中无超时限制的同步 TLS 握手允许未认证客户端阻塞连接，从而导致管理服务遭受拒绝服务攻击。

items.reason_en: CISA KEV-listed buffer overflow in Google Brotli compression library allows memory corruption, information disclosure, or RCE across platforms.
items.reason_zh: 被列入 CISA KEV 目录的 Google Brotli 压缩库缓冲区溢出漏洞可导致跨平台的内存损坏、信息泄露或远程代码执行（RCE）。

items.reason_en: CISA KEV-listed directory traversal in MONAI Label medical imaging AI platform leads to remote code execution, actively exploited in the wild.
items.reason_zh: 被列入 CISA KEV 目录的 MONAI Label 医学影像 AI 平台目录遍历漏洞可导致远程代码执行，且已在实际环境中被活跃利用。

items.reason_en: Heap buffer overflow in FFmpeg zmq/azmq filters allows unauthenticated memory corruption via oversized command messages, impacting media pipelines.
items.reason_zh: FFmpeg zmq/azmq 过滤器中的堆缓冲区溢出漏洞允许通过超大命令消息进行未认证的内存损坏，影响媒体处理管道。

items.reason_en: Unsafe reflection vulnerability in Elixir DBConnection allows forged stream structs to execute arbitrary code, affecting application data layers.
items.reason_zh: Elixir DBConnection 中的不安全反射漏洞允许伪造的流结构体执行任意代码，影响应用程序数据层。

items.reason_en: Typesense document deletion accepts unsanitized IDs via raw string concatenation, allowing attackers to inadvertently delete unintended records from vector databases.
items.reason_zh: Typesense 文档删除功能通过原始字符串拼接接受未过滤的 ID，攻击者可借此意外从向量数据库中删除非目标记录。

items.reason_en: Flawed ACME challenge routing in Zoraxy fails to validate URIs, permitting unauthenticated attackers to proxy requests to internal network services via SSRF.
items.reason_zh: Zoraxy 中缺陷的 ACME 挑战路由未能验证 URI，允许未认证攻击者通过 SSRF 将请求代理至内部网络服务。

items.reason_en: Critical file-write bypass in the Flyto2 AI execution kernel leaves CSV/JSON modules unprotected, allowing arbitrary filesystem modifications and potential RCE.
items.reason_zh: Flyto2 AI 执行内核中存在关键的文件写入绕过漏洞，导致 CSV/JSON 模块缺乏保护，允许任意文件系统修改及潜在的 RCE。

items.reason_en: Heap overflow in FFmpeg's WAV encoder triggers memory corruption when processing zero-channel audio streams, crashing media processing pipelines.
items.reason_zh: FFmpeg WAV 编码器中的堆溢出漏洞在处理零声道音频流时会触发内存损坏，导致媒体处理管道崩溃。
